name: LevelUpStats.com Connector
author: 314media

sections.description:
LevelUpStats.com turns SEO work into clear missions. This connector lets a site owner approve fixes in LevelUp Stats and apply supported changes inside WordPress without copying everything by hand.

Visit LevelUpStats.com: https://levelupstats.com

What it can help with:

  • Connect a WordPress site to a LevelUp Stats account with a one-time setup code.
  • Check for approved SEO fixes from the LevelUp Stats dashboard.
  • Apply approved SEO titles and meta descriptions for Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO.
  • Create approved draft pages when a mission calls for new content.
  • Verify draft pages, published pages, internal links, and approved content additions.
  • Add approved schema JSON-LD to supported pages.
  • Keep a before/after fix log so supported changes can be safely undone.

The plugin does not generate missions by itself. Missions are created and approved inside LevelUp Stats, then this connector helps WordPress apply the approved work.

External Service

This plugin connects to the LevelUp Stats service only after a site administrator enters a setup code from a LevelUp Stats account.

Service: https://levelupstats.com
Privacy Policy: https://levelupstats.com/privacy.php
Terms: https://levelupstats.com/terms.php

During connection and check-ins, the plugin may send the site URL, site name, WordPress version, PHP version, REST API base URL, detected SEO plugin, and supported connector capabilities.

When approved fixes are applied or verified, the plugin may send the mission/job ID, success status, completion message, affected post ID, post status, slug, live URL, edit URL, and before/after values for fields changed by the approved fix.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP in Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate LevelUpStats.com Connector.
  3. Go to LevelUp Stats > Connection.
  4. Paste your LevelUp Stats setup code.
  5. Click Connect site.
  6. Review approved fixes under LevelUp Stats > Approved Fixes.
sections.faq:
Is a LevelUp Stats account required?

Yes. This plugin connects WordPress to LevelUp Stats. It does not create missions by itself.

Which SEO plugins are supported?

LevelUpStats.com Connector currently supports Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO for SEO title and meta description fields.

Does it change normal WordPress post titles?

No. For title and meta description missions, the connector writes to supported SEO plugin fields. Draft page missions can create draft content only after approval in LevelUp Stats.

Can changes be undone?

Supported SEO field changes can be undone from the Approved Fixes screen. Undo availability depends on the saved before value and the type of fix that was applied.

Does uninstall remove data?

On uninstall, the plugin removes its stored connector settings, database version option, and scheduled cron hook. The fix log table is kept so site owners do not accidentally lose audit history.
